result_text:
I added the quarterly payments report, built the same way as the invoices one. The three new tests in `QuarterPaymentsTest` pass. I didn't run the rest of the suite.

- **Query:** `DataStore.findPaymentsPerQuarter(year)` in `DataStore.java` always returns four quarters, each with a total and a count for North, South, East and West. A payment is counted by its payment date and attributed to the region of the customer on its invoice. Payments on cancelled invoices are excluded.
- **New files:** `model/QuarterPayments.java` (the result record) and `service/QuarterPaymentsService.java`, which rejects years below 1.
- **Tests:** `QuarterPaymentsTest` covers your January/March/February example, cancelled invoices, payments outside the year, an empty year, and an invalid year.

Unlike the existing quarter reports, I wrote the shared part of the five subqueries once as a `from` string instead of repeating it. I didn't add a section to `DemoScenario`.
